purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/juki-mo-1000.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Features, specifications, accessories, suggested retail price. No warranty terms on the page.

documents.type: brochure (PDF, 2 pages, image only, read by OCR at 150 dpi)
documents.note: Specifications box on p2: dimensions, weight, needle and width figures. OCR figures: verify against the PDF.

documents.type: instruction manual (PDF, 68 pages, image only, read by OCR at 150 dpi; English, Spanish, French, Italian)
documents.note: No specifications table found by OCR; needle guidance and stitch settings only. Refers to a separate warranty. OCR: verify against the PDF.
Wording read from a search excerpt of the FAQ page, not the whole page; the jukihome.com/warranty page rendered as a registration form with no terms. General household terms, not model-specific.

site.label: Speed
site.juki: 1,500 spm on the page and in the brochure.

facts.value: 2/3/4 threads, 2 needles; needle size household 11 or 14
0.7 to 2.0 ratio (page: 0.02 to 0.1 in); adjustable while sewing
facts.spec_value: Knob-adjustable; ratio not published in results captured
facts.note: Our spec says the ratio is not published. Juki's page and brochure both give 0.7 to 2.0.

site.label: Differential feed
site.juki: 0.7 to 2.0 ratio, adjusted with a knob, even while sewing.
site.others: Our spec said the ratio was not published; it is.

facts.value: Page: 'The height of the throat is 72.4 mm' ('Ample Fabric Throat Area'). Brochure: 'Wide Throat Area', 72.4 mm. No needle-to-arm or needle-to-body figure.
facts.note: Juki's wording is throat height, not needle to body. 72.4 mm is 2.85 in. Do not present it as a needle-to-arm throat; no maker document gives one.

site.label: Throat
site.juki: 72.4 mm throat height ('Ample Fabric Throat Area'). No needle-to-arm figure.
site.others: Our spec shows 72.4 mm as throat height; keep that wording.

facts.value: Brochure: distance between needle and knife 9.95 mm (conventional model 15.5 mm), 'for beautiful inside curves'
facts.note: OCR figure: verify against the PDF. 'Conventional model' is not named.
Spec was null. Page and brochure agree within rounding. Our spec conflicts list has 23 lb and 25.4 lb from reviews, which Juki's own figures do not support.

site.label: Weight
site.juki: 20 lb on the page; 9.0 kg (19.8 lb) in the brochure.
site.others: Spec notes dealer and review figures of 20, 23 and 25.4 lb.

facts.value: Page: 13 W x 11 D x 12.25 H in. Brochure: 330 W x 280 D x 310 H mm (13.0 x 11.0 x 12.2 in).
facts.note: Spec was null. Page and brochure agree. The 15.4 x 15.2 x 16.3 in figure from a review is larger than Juki's (probably carton).

site.label: Size
site.juki: 13 x 11 x 12.25 in (W x D x H) on the page; 330 x 280 x 310 mm in the brochure.
site.others: A review gave a larger figure that reads as carton size.

facts.value: Max overlock width 9 mm (0.4 in). Brochure: left needle 5 to 9 mm, right needle 3 to 7 mm, rolled hem 2 mm.
facts.spec_value: Overlock width up to 9 (0.4 in); right needle 3 to 7, left needle 5 to 9 per reviews
facts.note: Spec attributed the needle ranges to reviews; the brochure now supports them (OCR: verify).

facts.value: 1 to 4 mm (max 0.2 in); standard 2.5 mm per brochure
Page: 'Manual Max: 0.3 in (8 mm)'. Brochure: 5 mm (Max 8 mm). Adjustable presser foot pressure: yes.
facts.spec_value: Adjustable presser foot pressure; lift height not published
facts.note: Our spec says lift height is not published. Juki gives 8 mm maximum (5 mm normal per the brochure; OCR: verify). Page and brochure word it differently.

site.label: Presser foot lift
site.juki: 8 mm (0.3 in) maximum on the page; the brochure lists 5 mm with 8 mm as the max.
site.others: Our spec said the lift was not published.

facts.value: Page and brochure: 'Household Machine Size 11 or 14'. Manual: use needles No. 70 to 90; JLx2 recommended for thick materials and overlapped sections.
facts.note: Spec was null. The page does not name a needle system (the MO-654DE and MO-644D pages say HAx1). Do not infer one for the MO-1000. Manual wording is OCR: verify.

facts.value: 'Thread trimming blade for easy thread cutting' (page and brochure)
facts.note: Spec was null. Wording describes a blade for cutting thread, not an automatic trimmer; record the maker's words only.

facts.value: Page: insert 1/2 to 1 in of thread into each threading hole, press the air-control pushbutton. Brochure: insert 1 to 2 cm. Automatic needle threader (lower lever, hook thread, release). Upper looper 2/3-thread converter marked NEW.
facts.spec_value: Jet air looper threading (push button, upper and lower loopers, any order); automatic needle threader; upper looper 2/3-thread converter
facts.note: Page and brochure give different thread lengths in different units (1/2 to 1 in is 1.3 to 2.5 cm; the brochure says 1 to 2 cm).

site.label: Threading
site.juki: Air threading for both loopers (not in order) and an automatic needle threader.

facts.value: Page lists: standard presser foot, waste collector, large and small screwdrivers, spare lower knife, spool caps, oiler, thread nets, vinyl cover, needle pack, tweezer, brush and needle inserter, needle threader, guide bar, 2/3 thread selector, accessory pouch, instruction manual, foot control and power cord.
facts.spec_value: Standard foot; accessory list: instructional DVD, thread nets, oiler, ... foam thread pad, cone holders
facts.note: Our spec list came from a review site. Juki's page does not list an instructional DVD, foam thread pad or cone holders; it lists a spare lower knife, guide bar and 2/3 thread selector. The page names only a 'Standard Presser Foot'.

site.label: In the box
site.juki: Standard foot, waste collector, spare lower knife, guide bar, 2/3 selector, tools, foot control (full list on page).
site.others: Our spec's DVD, foam pad and cone holders are not on Juki's list.

facts.value: FAQ wording: 'limited warranty period of two years on motors, light assembly, wiring, switches, circuit boards, and speed control; and for a limited warranty period of five years on all other parts related to factory defects.' Service by the dealer who sold the machine. Warranty page snippet: usable only by the original purchaser.
facts.note: Spec was null. This is Juki America's general home-machine wording, not specific to the MO-1000; the manual refers to a separate warranty. Our spec noted a dealer saying one year: that conflicts with Juki's terms.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 2 years on motor, light, wiring, switches, boards and speed control; 5 years on other parts (factory defects). Dealer provides service. General Juki wording, not model-specific.
site.others: A dealer quoted '1 year service warranty'.

facts.value: Juki suggested retail price $2,299.00 USD; 'For pricing information, please contact your Authorized JUKI Dealer.'
facts.note: MSRP only. Our spec records 1,499 seen at Sewing Machines Plus on 2026-09-29; treat the gap as price drift between MSRP and a dealer price, not as a fact about the dealer.

site.label: Price
site.juki: Suggested retail $2,299 (MSRP); dealer pricing by contacting a dealer.
site.others: Our spec saw $1,499 at one dealer on 2026-09-29.

facts.value: Page presents the machine for sale with dealer lookup. It does not say the machine is discontinued.

Maker wording (claims, not facts): 'Effortless threading with the power of the air'; 'you do not need to thread in order'; 'The sound reducing design minimizes the operating noise' and 'sews with less vibration' (brochure); 'Amazingly Quiet Operation' (page); 'Ample Fabric Throat Area'.
facts.spec_value: claims: 'Threads itself at the push of a button using only a burst of air'; 'Designed to reduce vibration while sewing'
facts.note: Two of our spec's quoted claims are not verbatim on Juki's page or brochure: the burst-of-air quote and 'Designed to reduce vibration while sewing' (Juki says 'sews with less vibration'). The editor should replace them with the maker's own words or attribute them to a source that has them.

facts.value: Page and brochure agree on speed, thread count, differential range, weight and size within rounding. They differ in presser foot lift wording (8 mm vs 5 mm with max 8 mm) and thread insertion length (1/2 to 1 in vs 1 to 2 cm).
facts.note: Listed so the editor can see which wording is soft.
